source_event.summary: Independent audit found durable truth could be erased at the public result after a downstream failure, plus a documentation contract drift.

generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A workflow commits its primary durable effect, then a later lookup, enrichment, dispatcher, or provider-preparation step fails and the caller incorrectly reports the committed effect as absent.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Wrap the whole operation in one broad error mapping so every downstream exception is reclassified as failure of the already-committed primary effect.
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: After a durable truth boundary, preserve the committed fact in every result path and represent downstream failures separately without hidden retry or outbound.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Inject failure at the first step after durable persistence, then at the dispatcher, and exercise a disabled external route; assert persisted truth, separate secondary state, and outbound counts.

transfer_cases.scenario: receipt persists before enrichment lookup fails
job persists before notifier preparation fails

skill_changes.change: Added generic durable-truth boundary preservation and POST-DURABLE-TRUTH-001.
Added generic post-commit failure injection, dispatcher sibling, disabled-route sibling, and outbound-count assertions.
